tido-juridiskt-stod-brottsoffer::sfs-202.label: none
tido-juridiskt-stod-brottsoffer::sfs-202.reason: The judge called it full, but SFS 2023:311 only adjusts the conditions for appointing a målsägandebiträde; the measure the promise asks for sits in SFS 2023:312, which keeps its judged label.

tido-ny-socialtjanstlag-brottsforebyggan.label: partial
tido-ny-socialtjanstlag-brottsforebyggan.reason: The judge called it full from the framing of the proposition alone; the new Socialtjänstlag does not by itself deliver the crime-prevention commitment of the promise, so it covers only part of it.

tido-skolor-stangda-obehoriga::sfs-2025-.label: none
tido-skolor-stangda-obehoriga::sfs-2025-.reason: The judge called it full on the strength of a broad Education Act amendment; the provision on unauthorised persons in school areas is in SFS 2025:625, which keeps its judged label.

tido-likvardig-kvalitet-foreskrifter-min.label: none
tido-likvardig-kvalitet-foreskrifter-min.reason: The judge called it partial, but the law only strengthens school libraries; none of the items the promise lists (minimum guaranteed teaching time, lab equipment, school yards, pupil health, teaching materials) is in it.

tido-likvardig-kvalitet-foreskrifter-min.reason: The judge called it partial, but the law only strengthens school libraries; none of the items the promise lists (minimum guaranteed teaching time, lab equipment, school yards, pupil health, teaching materials) is in it.

tido-utokad-timplan-svenska-matematik::s.label: none
tido-utokad-timplan-svenska-matematik::s.reason: The judge called it partial, but the law (a ten-year compulsory school) does not expand the timetable with a focus on Swedish and mathematics, which is what the promise asks for; the expansion for those subjects is only an inquiry proposal.
